text:
Alex (Sales): Hey team — enterprise prospect asked for SOC 2 report excerpts and a short bridge note so they can start a POC next week. They also want confirmation on NDA timing. Can we get an expedited plan?
Maria R. (Solutions): Do we have a redacted SOC 2 extract we can share under NDA? Typical ask is control mappings + scope page.
Ryan S. (AE): Customer (Emma) said they need access by Tue EOD. They're ok with an interim bridge letter while legal finalizes the NDA.
Lena (Legal): We can't provide any SOC artifacts without an NDA in place. We can offer a standard one-way NDA and a short bridge letter summarizing compliance posture (not the full report).
Alex (Sales): If we get the NDA signed today can legal send a presigned S3 link for the redacted extracts? They prefer S3 over email.
Lena (Legal): Yes. Once NDA is fully executed we can issue a presigned S3 link with scoped objects and 48h expiry. We will redact personnel names and any customer-specific data.
sec-bot: Reminder: Access logs enabled and KMS encryption enforced on bucket.
Maria R. (Solutions): For the bridge letter content, can we include: scope (prod infra), last SOC 2 date, controls tested, and planned remediation windows? Keep it high-level.
Lena (Legal): We can include date and scope and confirm we maintain SOC 2 Type II for the infra and ops controls. No raw evidence, no internal tickets.
Ops (Infra): I'll prepare an export: 
```
- scope-summary.pdf
- control-matrix-redacted.csv
- system-description-redacted.pdf
```
Will push to the staging bucket after legal sign-off.
Ryan S. (AE): ETA for upload if NDA signed today?
Lena (Legal): If we get signed NDA by 16:00 PT, Ops can upload and I will send presigned link by 18:00 PT (48h expiry). If customer needs longer we can do a 5-day window but need approval.
Emma (Customer): Confirming we'll sign NDA today. One ask — can the bridge letter explicitly state we can rely on it for initial risk assessment?
Lena (Legal): Bridge letter will state it's provided for evaluation purposes and not a substitute for a full report. We'll include contact to request deeper review under a formal data room process.
Alex (Sales): Great — I'll ping Emma with the NDA and timeline. Anyone want me to copy the standard NDA template or does legal want to send?
Lena (Legal): I'll send the NDA with a special clause for temporary evidence access and include a line about limited presigned link access.
Maria R. (Solutions): Quick technical note for the bucket: set presigned URL to GET only, IP-restrict if possible, and log request IDs in case customer asks for access audit.
Ops (Infra): Can do GET-only and IP allowlist. Leave IPs here and we'll add.
Ryan S. (AE): Emma — what's your IP? (or range).
Emma (Customer): Our security team will provide an IP range in the NDA cover email.
Alex (Sales): Next steps I have: 1) Lena sends NDA, 2) Emma signs, 3) Ops uploads redacted artifacts, 4) Lena sends presigned link + bridge letter. Aim: Tue morning for customer access.
Lena (Legal): Sounds good. I'll draft the bridge letter today and circulate for one quick technical accuracy review with Maria before sending.
Maria R. (Solutions): I'll review ASAP once Lena posts the draft.
sec-bot: Note — please avoid sharing raw logs or PII in the uploaded artifacts.
Alex (Sales): Thanks everyone. I'll update the CRM and add a task for follow-up after access is granted. :thumbsup:
